summary: Preserve incremental ETA triggers across rollback of newly created stores

replay.detail: Duration samples and publication semantics are unchanged.

schema.detail: Record the older ETA initialization marker during store opening so the older writer does not replace the current trigger layout.

rules.detail: Selected-attempt accounting and newest-64 candidate bounds are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The older writer recognizes its initialization marker and retains the newer triggers. No public schema change.

downtime.detail: The marker is recorded during normal store opening.

recovery.detail: Rollback and re-upgrade retain the incremental terminal-transition trigger.
